'''Jolda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when she was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Jolda appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Dromund Kaas Equipment Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock, though she was later relabeled as the Level 13 Equipment Vendor. She is identical to the Dromund Kaas Modifications Commendations vendor, Sergeant [[Kidles (female)|Kidles]], and two male vendors in the area also named Sergeant [[Kidles (male)|Kidles]] and Sergeant [[Jolda (male)|Jolda]]. The female Sergeant Jolda was later removed from the game along with the rest of the planetary Equipment Commendations vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]]; that update also replaced Sergeant Kidles with a new character, Sergeant [[Kanzin]].<ref name="TOR" />
